newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to absorb one trln won through repos.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to absorb one trln won through repos.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea (BOK) plans to absorb one trillion won from the banking system through repurchase agreements (repos) maturing next Monday, a BOK official said on Friday.
Repos are bonds issued by the central bank to control money in circulation.
"Banks with abundant short-term liquidity asked the central bank to siphon off surplus money in circulation," the official said.
He said market liquidity would remain stable despite the repos.
But the central bank was considering releasing funds in early April to help companies pay taxes, he added.
